purpose: Teach: 操る/根元/下回る/追いかける/雇わ/不変/定住/外れる

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ゲームのキャラを操るの上手いな
lines.en: Riku, you're actually good at controlling game characters.
lines.style: Warm teasing with genuine admiration underneath. Quick, almost casual. Slight lean-in with the observation, like she's caught him at something. Eye contact steady but not holding too long.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、木の根元で休んでたな、桜
lines.en: You were resting by the tree roots back there, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Light, observational tone. Not accusatory—just noticing. Soft delivery on the question tag, like he's mildly amused at catching her in a quiet moment. Cool but not distant.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、平均点を下回るのが心配だな
lines.en: Riku, you're probably worried about falling below the average score.
lines.style: Dry, knowing tone. A little pointed but not unkind. She's reading him and both of them know it. Slight smirk in the delivery—testing whether he'll admit it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、犬を追いかけるの好きだろ?桜
lines.en: You like chasing dogs around, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Wry deflection—turns her observation back on her. Lighter pace, slightly defensive but wrapped in humor. Not mean, just: I see what you're doing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、バイトで雇われたな
lines.en: Riku, you got hired for that part-time job.
lines.style: Direct, with a note of quiet approval. Not making a big deal of it but noting it happened. Steady eye contact. The kind of statement that means she's proud and isn't hiding it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、友達への気持ち、不変だな、桜
lines.en: Your feelings toward your friends—they don't change, do they, Sakura?
lines.style: Tender but careful. Slow delivery on the observation. He's being sincere here, which makes him slightly vulnerable. Slight trailing-off, like he's said something true and is letting it sit.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ここに定住する気だろ?
lines.en: Riku, you're planning to settle down here, aren't you?
lines.style: Wry, testing tone. Not quite teasing—more probing. Slight rise at the end like she's asking him something he hasn't admitted to himself yet. Cool surface, curious underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、自転車のチェーンが外れる事よくあるな、桜
lines.en: Your bike chain comes off all the time, doesn't it, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry, close-up delivery. Almost matter-of-fact but with a wry edge underneath. Quick pace. Like he's calling her out on something small and specific—not to hurt, but because he's noticed.
